newsitem.title: UK: Midland Ind in takeover talks with Mirror.
newsitem.headline: Midland Ind in takeover talks with Mirror.

text.p: Midland Independent Newspapers Plc said on Tuesday it was talks with Mirror Group Plc which might lead to an offer being made for the company.
"The company is involved in discussions with Mirror Group Plc which may or may not lead to an offer being made for the company," said Midland Independent in a statement.
It addded both boards were exploring the level of benefits which would accrue from a combination of their respective businesses.
Midland noted any offer would be subject to a mandatory reference to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
By 1151 GMT, shares in Midland had climbed 39-1/2p to 188-1/2p.
Midland made the statement in response to the recent rise in its share price, which dealers said had been linked to renewed rumours of a bid for the company.
